c-74a0c3e1345171da.texto: See also chapter 3:29. Cutting into pieces was a punishment common to many ancient nations. It was known to the Hebrews, and was inflicted by Samuel upon Agag. See 1 Samuel 15:33. Some think that dichotomy, or sawing asunder, is the punishment here referred to. See note on Hebrew…

h-15bcc05b53d236b9.texto: JFB introducción a Daniel discute extensamente la disputa: desde Nabucodonosor (Dn 1:1, ~605 a.C.) hasta 'el tercer año de Ciro' (Dn 10:1, ~536 a.C.), y refuta explícitamente la postura de que el libro sea 'una falsificación de la época de los Macabeos (170-164 a.C.)'.
